name: Nebula
author: E. T. Carter
description: A Trifid-style emission/reflection nebula — billowing domain-warped gas fills the frame, a warm pink emission region glowing in the lower body and cooling to a blue reflection haze toward the top, woven along a noisy seam. Branching dark dust lanes carve trifurcating channels through the clouds while a dense field of varied stars twinkles behind and through them, with a couple of bright young stars embedded in the gas. Everything billows on slow unbounded drift.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed at which the gas clouds billow and churn; 0 freezes the scene, high values keep the nebula visibly flowing.

params.label: Dust lanes
params.effect: Prominence of the dark branching dust lanes cutting through the gas — 0 leaves the clouds open and luminous, high values carve deep trifurcating channels.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: How thickly stars fill the field behind and through the gas, from a sparse scatter to a crowded sky.

params.label: Gas scale
params.effect: Spatial scale of the gas and dust structure — low gives broad sweeping clouds, high a finer, more turbulent filigree.
